# Nanolaba Readme Generator (NRG)

> Java 8+ tool that generates README.md, README.ru.md and any other localized Markdown file from one `*.src.md` template, and fails CI when the generated files drift from it. Ships as a CLI, a Maven plugin, a GitHub Action and a Java library. Latest release: 1.4.

Templates are `*.src.md` files; the `*.md` files they produce are build output and must not be edited by hand. Validate a template with `nrg --validate -f README.src.md`, regenerate with `nrg -f README.src.md`, find the template line behind a generated line with `nrg --locate README.md:LINE`. Add `--format json` for machine-readable results.

## Docs

- [Syntax card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nanolaba/readme-generator/main/skills/nrg/SYNTAX.md): the whole template syntax and every widget's parameters on one page
- [Using NRG with AI coding agents](https://github.com/nanolaba/readme-generator#using-nrg-with-ai-coding-agents): the validate / generate / check loop, an AGENTS.md block, edit-guard hooks, the nrgw wrapper
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nanolaba/readme-generator/main/README.md): full documentation
- [Template syntax](https://github.com/nanolaba/readme-generator#template-syntax): languages, properties, escapes, ignore and frozen regions
- [Widgets](https://github.com/nanolaba/readme-generator#widgets): import, tableOfContents, if, details, alert, badge, date, todo, math, exec, fileTree, languages
- [Command line](https://github.com/nanolaba/readme-generator#using-the-command-line-interface): every CLI option, exit codes, JSON output
